name: AnesSuite
description: AnesSuite is a comprehensive dataset suite and benchmark designed to evaluate anesthesiology reasoning in large language models. It includes AnesBench for assessing reasoning at multiple levels and three training datasets for continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, supporting development of specialized medical reasoning models.
reputation: A new specialized medical benchmark for anesthesiology reasoning; promising but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Includes training datasets and baseline models; focuses on anesthesiology reasoning and general medical reasoning capabilities.
